drugs.name: Capecitabine
howToTake: Take twice a day, about 12 hours apart
Swallow whole with water within 30 minutes after a meal
Usually 14 days on, then 7 days off
getHelpIf: Diarrhoea 4 or more extra times a day

drugs.name: Imatinib
howToTake: Take once a day at the same time
Take with food and a large glass of water
Keep taking it every day unless your doctor says stop

drugs.name: Tamoxifen
howToTake: Take once a day at the same time
You can take it with or without food
getHelpIf: Pain or swelling in one leg
